claimChecks.claim: A 60-degree Z gives guaranteed 50–70% clinical gain and 90-degree scar rotation at every site
claimChecks.locator: Authored HTML basic technique/geometric-versus-clinical length paragraph and original site SVG
claimChecks.note: Ideal equal-limb gain about 73% with 90-degree reorientation; real gain lower/variable and site-specific.

claimChecks.claim: Serial Z-plasties necessarily lower flap-tip necrosis versus one large Z
claimChecks.locator: Salam complications and Yotsuyanagi eight-case abstract
claimChecks.note: Technique can distribute a long scar but neither cited source establishes a universal comparative necrosis reduction.

claimChecks.claim: 97% of all 100 pediatric patients had stable repair after one year
claimChecks.locator: Original indexed abstract Methods and Results
claimChecks.note: 97% completed scheduled follow-up; all completers reported stable correction; 98% primary healing is separate.

claimChecks.claim: Z preputioplasty significantly reduces later circumcision versus standard
claimChecks.locator: Original indexed Results: 1/11 versus 5/22, p=.33, cosmetic p=.005
claimChecks.note: Subsequent-circumcision difference nonsignificant; cosmetic rating difference significant in small nonrandomized cohort.

claimChecks.claim: Frenuloplasty satisfaction and 8% later circumcision are Z-only results
claimChecks.locator: Original indexed Methods and Results: V-Y, Z or both; 9/96 and 84/87
claimChecks.note: Mixed-technique outcomes and responder denominators preserved explicitly.

claimChecks.claim: AUA endorses Z-plasty for Peyronie's tunical reconstruction
claimChecks.note: AUA discusses plaque incision/excision and grafting for adequate rigidity, not a named cutaneous Z-plasty.

claimChecks.claim: 33%/67% oncologic figures are Z-plasty usage rates
claimChecks.note: Figures are plastic-surgeon involvement in scrotal SCC/Paget Mohs cases, not Z technique.

claimChecks.claim: ACOG requires Z-plasty after transverse septum excision
claimChecks.locator: ACOG Transverse Vaginal Septum paragraph; Wierrani 13-case abstract
claimChecks.note: ACOG says may improve flap length/reduce narrowing; 13-case outcome not proof over all alternatives.

claimChecks.locator: Original indexed Methods/Results: 3 Z, 8 incision, 8 advancement, 1 graft
claimChecks.note: Those outcomes pooled four operations; only three Z recipients.

claimChecks.claim: Plymouth procedure should be universal after failed Fenton's
claimChecks.locator: Original indexed retrospective questionnaire and author conclusion
claimChecks.note: Retained as author proposal, not a comparative or general recommendation.

claimChecks.claim: Z-modified KDPIF had fewer serious complications and lower scar scores
claimChecks.note: One versus six serious complications and lower POSAS in source abstract; full adjustment and table pending.
